_readme: The home page reads this file and shows one card per tool. To add a new tool: create its folder, then add an entry here. status can be "ready", "beta" or "planned".

tools.title: Games Finder
tools.tagline: Find the perfect game for your meeting.
tools.description: Search 50+ tried-and-tested games by section, length, theme and setting. Every game comes with clear rules, equipment, safety notes and leader tips — plus variants and themed twists.

tools.title: Kit List Generator
tools.tagline: Build a tailored kit list for your next adventure.
tools.description: Answer a few questions about your trip, weather and activities. Get a branded PDF to send home and a CSV checklist you can paste into Online Scout Manager — with quantities that change with the number of nights.
